title: Rhythm Sprint 2 — Onset RCA

notes.F_beam_grouping: Low as sole primary label, but is the dominant mechanism inside A for vector fixtures: refineEventDurationsFromBeamEvidence caps only, never floors short gaps under primary-beam evidence.
notes.G_measure_packing: split-measure co-occurs on dense/standard-chords; do not treat as primary onset root cause. Tab uneven slots classified under A.

postSprint1Evidence.mechanism: buildNoteEventsFromGroups assigns duration from position gap; refineEventDurationsFromBeamEvidence only shortens when duration > inferredBeamDurationCap; durationDivisions=1 survives on beams=1 / beamStrength>=8 notes.

productionPaths.inferNoteDuration: beams>=2 → sixteenth; beams>=1||beamStrength>=8 → eighth; strength alone never sixteenth
productionPaths.measureBeamStrength: 1-D tip-row scan; cannot see secondary beam
productionPaths.gapPrimary: position delta of 1 division emits sixteenth events

proposedTrueSixteenthRecognition.idea: After primary beam at tipY, scan parallel rows ~0.35–0.7 staff-space for second horizontal ink run ≥8px → beams=2. Do NOT use saturated strength.
proposedTrueSixteenthRecognition.optional: partial-beam stubs / double-flag near tip when no primary beam

recommendedFixes.title: Beam duration floor for primary-beam notes
recommendedFixes.change: When beams===1 or beamStrength>=8 and beams<2, if gap duration < eighth, raise to eighth (and preferably re-snap following same-clef onset).

recommendedFixes.title: Secondary-beam row scan for beams=2
recommendedFixes.change: Detect real secondary beam ink on parallel tip-offset rows; enable true sixteenths without restoring strength≥14→sixteenth.
recommendedFixes.expectedImpact: True 16ths (e.g. tuplets m2) after Fix 1 floors primary beams

recommendedFixes.title: Tab beat-grid slot packing
recommendedFixes.change: Suppress spurious leading 16th / d=3 slots when ~beat-count groups should land on quarter beats.

traps: Gap-primary owns event duration; notehead durationType is advisory.
Sprint-1 cap does not floor short gaps.
countBeams never returns 2 today — beams>=2 branch is dead.
Chord sequentialization is a separate onset source on dense.
TAB path is detectTabNotation, not processVectorOmrPage.
Diagnostics SIXTEENTH_BEAM_STRENGTH=14 must not re-enter production duration.
Tuplets m2 truth is real 16ths — Fix 1 without Fix 2a can over-floor.
